title: Independent review of proposed co-mutation contribution
scope: Statistical helper functions and static selection review only
finding: 103 Fisher tests and BH examples agree with SciPy; full dataset not rerun
unresolved: First sample is lexical ID order, not established collection chronology
Absence of a mutation or CNA event is not independently verified as adequate locus coverage
Carrier groups are built from selected sample subsets; definition must be explicit
Symmetric gain/loss does not logically prove zero treatment signal

title: Independent co-mutation recount and CNA spot-check
scope: Claude independently reimplemented public cBioPortal cohort and assay checks; Codex reviewed the aggregate package and independently spot-checked 100 samples for CNA API zero semantics
finding: The submitted rule is arithmetically reproducible, but control selection, partial panel coverage and CNA missingness require correction. In a direct 100-sample API check, 6705 zero rows were off-panel and 52 samples had no ALL rows.
unresolved: Full-cohort CNA totals from the independent Claude implementation were not separately re-run by Codex
Revised original biological claims and coverage-aware denominators need review
Locus-level callability and chronology are not exposed in the public API
